::: {.section-card}
### AI offers — NACE divisions and transversal skills

Within professional and ICT services, AI demand is concentrated in a handful of NACE divisions — especially **computer programming (K62)** and **engineering & technical consultancy (N71)**. Transversal skills appear in roughly **two thirds** of AI-tagged offers; **self-management (T3)** and **basic skills (T1)** are the most common transversal groups among those postings.
